messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: apigw-eu-west reporting elevated 502/504s (5m window) — error rate ~18%, p95 latency 2.5s. Paging @maya (oncall). Grafana: https://grafana.redwood/alert/8421 :rotating_light:
maya (oncall): ack, I'm on it
maya (oncall): quick check - any recent deploys?
aj: no deploys in the last 30m, last deploy 1h ago (gitsha: a1b2c3)
sam: seeing lots of `TCP RST` on edge-proxy-2a, and upstream 504s from ld-inference pool
kyle (sre): pulling logs now, running a few curls to reproduce: `curl -sv https://apigw-eu-west/redwood/v1/health` -> frequent 502 responses with `upstream: read timeout`
maya (oncall): sounds like backend timeouts + proxy fanout. mitigation plan: 1) enable route-level circuit-breaker for /v1/generate, 2) reduce max_parallel to limit backend concurrency, 3) shift some EU traffic to us-west as a safety valve
aj: prepping envoy patch, will flip circuit-breaker to TRIP at 50% failures and set max_connections=64 for problematic cluster
aj: applying patch: ```
# envoy patch (abridged)
cluster: ld-inference
circuit_breakers:
  thresholds:
    - max_connections: 64
      max_pending_requests: 100
```
ops-bot: rollout started by aj — change-id: change-7845, tracking https://ci.redwood/changes/7845
sam: initiating traffic shift: traffic-manager -> route eu-west: -20% to us-west; canary window 5m
maya (oncall): customer-impact: roughly 10% of requests to /v1/generate are failing; outbound retries causing cascading load. filling incident triage sheet: https://docs.redwood/incidents/1771234560
kyle (sre): KV cache miss rate for ld-inference up +12% in the same window — backend cold-starts or overloaded workers plausible
aj: circuit-breaker applied, envoy reports `CB_OPEN` for ~3 endpoints, pushing new config to all edge-proxies
ops-bot: config rollout completed on edge-proxy fleet (ID: fleet-22), verified by healthcheck jobs
sam: after shift + cb, error rate dropped -> 6% over last 3m, p95 down to 900ms
maya (oncall): nice. keep an eye on latency tail; keep traffic shift active until stable for 15m
statuspage-bot: Posted update: "Investigating: Elevated API Gateway errors in EU region. Mitigations in progress." https://status.redwood/incidents/INC-4721
maya (oncall): planning handoff in 25m to aj; aj will be primary. I'll run through customer impact notes then step OOO for short break
aj: acked, I'll monitor and coordinate with SRE. I'll open a support note to the top 10 customers impacted and include mitigation steps + ETA
kyle (sre): I'll own the postmortem, will collect traces, slow queries, and worker metrics. assigning doc `postmortem/INC-4721-kyle`
maya (oncall): quick runbook note: consider temporary decrease of request fanout to inference pool, and evaluate increasing worker count if we see sustained misses
aj: adding that to ops checklist. starting a gradual revert of the traffic-shift after 20m stable window
sam: monitoring — error rate now hovering 0.8% after 18:57 UTC, p95 180ms
maya (oncall): :thumbsup: great job team. I'll mark incident as monitoring and hand off to aj for watch. Leaving a short post on #customers to say we're monitoring and resolved for most users
statuspage-bot: Update posted: "Mitigation applied, error rates falling. Monitoring."
incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: error rate stabilized below 1% at 18:57 UTC. Team continuing monitoring; postmortem assigned to kyle (sre).
